Espace de travail moderne et épuré avec ordinateur et notes

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Google Fonts 'Fraunces' and 'Poppins' in index.html or index.css.
Persist all state (Energy level, Élan/Refuge mode, Mode Foi toggle, Theme preference, Ideas list, Today's actions, Chat history) in localStorage.
Ensure every interactive element (buttons, tabs, toggles, inputs) includes a explicit data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='elan-refuge-toggle', data-testid='faith-mode-switch').
Never use transparent backgrounds without blur/solid fallbacks for dropdowns or modals.
All text must meet high contrast ratios in both dark and light themes.
